finalText:
I changed nothing. I found no API or SDK change that breaks this code now or within the next 90 days (by 2027-02-01), and no later deprecation to list.

What the repo uses and what I checked:
- **Groq chat completions:** the code uses the model `openai/gpt-oss-120b` with `max_completion_tokens` and `reasoning_effort`. Groq's deprecation page lists several 2026 retirements. These include llama-3.1-8b-instant, llama-3.3-70b-versatile, qwen3-32b, kimi-k2, the llama-4 models and groq/compound. `openai/gpt-oss-120b` isn't among them, and Groq names it as the replacement for several of those models.
- **Stripe (`stripe` ^22.0.0, locked at 22.0.0):** the code calls `checkout.sessions.create` and `.retrieve`, `billingPortal.sessions.create` and `webhooks.constructEvent`. The v22 changelog I found covers type-export and TypeScript changes, which don't affect this plain CommonJS code. I loaded the installed package and confirmed those three methods exist. I couldn't retrieve the v22 migration guide or the API version it pins, so that part rests on the changelog summary and the method check.
- **OpenDota:** `/api/matches/{id}`, `/api/heroStats` and `/api/heroes/{id}/matchups`. I found no change affecting them. I didn't run a dedicated search for OpenDota changes, so this check was lighter than the others.
- **Not checked:** `@upstash/redis`, `axios`, `express`, `dotaconstants` and `@vercel/node`. I didn't research changes for these, and none of my findings touch them.

Sources:
- https://console.groq.com/docs/deprecations
- https://app.unpkg.com/stripe@22.0.0/files/CHANGELOG.md
- https://releases.sh/stripe/stripe-node/highlights
